players.bio: Anthony Jung (born 3 November 1991) is a German professional footballer who plays as a left-back or centre-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg. Club career Early career Jung played youth football for multiple clubs in the Wiesbaden area before joining the Eintracht Frankfurt youth academy in 2005.
Berkay Yılmaz (born 25 February 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back. Born in Germany, he is a youth international for Turkey.
Bruno Ifechukwu Ogbus (born 17 December 2005) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a right-back for club SC Freiburg.
Christian Günter (born 28 February 1993) is a German footballer who plays as a left-back for SC Freiburg.

Cyriaque Kalou Bi Irié (born 20 June 2005) is a Burkinabé professional footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg. Born in the Ivory Coast, he plays for the Burkina Faso national team.
Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (born 8 March 1996) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward for SC Freiburg and the Ghana national team.
erry Lionel Scherhant (born 10 November 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a striker for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg.
Florian Lorenz Müller (German pronunciation: ; born 13 November 1997) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Freiburg.

Jan-Niklas Beste (born 4 January 1999) is a German professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bundesliga club 1. FC Heidenheim. Club career After joining Borussia Dortmund at the age of eight, Beste made his competitive debut for the senior squad on 12 August 2017 in a 2017–18 DFB-Pokal match-up against Rielasingen-Arlen.
Jannik Huth (born 15 April 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg.
Jordy Makengo Basambundu (born 3 August 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for SC Freiburg II.

Julian Schuster (born 15 April 1985) is a German football manager and former player who is the currently head coach of Bundesliga club SC Freiburg. Schuster played as a midfielder and spent the bulk of his career at SC Freiburg.

Keisuke Gotō (後藤 啓介, Gotō Keisuke; born 3 June 2005) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Belgian Pro League club Sint-Truiden, on loan from Anderlecht, and the Japan national team.
Lucas Höler (born 10 July 1994) is a German footballer who plays as a forward for SC Freiburg.
Lukas Kübler is a German professional footballer who plays as a center back for SC Freiburg.
Matthias Lukas Ginter (born 19 January 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Germany national team.

Maximilian Eggestein (born 8 December 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as an midfielder for SC Freiburg. He is also the older brother of fellow professional footballer Johannes Eggestein.

Maximilian Marcus Philipp (born 1 March 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg. He represented Germany internationally at youth levels U20 and U21.
Maximilian Rosenfelder (born 10 February 2003) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for SC Freiburg.
Mio Backhaus (born 16 April 2004) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen.
Nicolas Höfler (born 9 March 1990) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for SC Freiburg.
Patrick Osterhage (born 1 February 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for VfL Bochum.
Philipp Lienhart (born 11 July 1996) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Austria national team.
Philipp Treu (born 3 December 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Bundesliga club SC Freiburg.
Vincenzo Grifo (born 7 April 1993) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger or midfielder for SC Freiburg and the Italy national team.
Yannik Engelhardt (born 7 February 2001) is a German professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach, on loan from Serie A club Como.

Yuito Suzuki (鈴木 唯人, Suzuki Yuito; born 25 October 2001) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
